mechanism: reciprocal co-immunoprecipitation (anti-STIM1 and anti-TRPML1) in differentiated NSC-34 motor neuron cells; co-localization quantified by immunofluorescence and lost when TRPML1 is silenced
sentence: In addition, TRPML1 co-immunoprecipitated with the ER Ca2+ sensor STIM1.
justification: A physical link between the lysosomal Ca2+ channel TRPML1 and the anchor STIM1, i.e. a lysosome-ER contact point feeding the same store that drives SOCE.

mechanism: siRNA knockdown of STING in T80 ovarian epithelial cells after dsDNA (plasmid) transfection; PLSCR1 protein measured by western blot
sentence: Strikingly, knockdown of STING dramatically reduced PLSCR1 protein.
justification: STING controls the level of PLSCR1, a Ca2+-dependent phospholipid scramblase in the curator's catalogue: an output of the STING arm that lands on calcium-dependent machinery.

mechanism: siRNA knockdown of IRF3 in T80 cells after dsDNA transfection ablates PLSCR1 induction while STING protein is unchanged, placing IRF3 downstream of STING
sentence: Knockdown of STING, STAT1, or IRF3 leads to reduced PLSCR1 protein.
justification: The transcriptional step between the anchor STING1 and PLSCR1, so the calcium-side output is attached to the arm that produces it rather than to STING alone.

mechanism: lentiviral expression of enzymatically active cGAS in human STAT1-/- fibroblasts; the antiviral program is lost when STING is silenced by siRNA and absent in Huh7 cells, which lack STING
sentence: These data indicate that, in STAT1-/- fibroblasts, lentiviral-driven cGAS expression activates IRF3 through STING and establishes a transcriptional program that inhibits infection of several RNA viruses.
justification: The canonical input to the anchor STING1, shown here independently of IFN/STAT1 signalling.

mechanism: same experiment: cGAS-driven IRF3 phosphorylation and ISG induction require STING, and are absent in STING-deficient Huh7 cells
sentence: These data indicate that, in STAT1-/- fibroblasts, lentiviral-driven cGAS expression activates IRF3 through STING and establishes a transcriptional program that inhibits infection of several RNA viruses.
justification: The output arm of the anchor STING1, independent of canonical IFN signalling.
